Denzel Washington returns to one of his signature roles in the first sequel of his career. Robert McCall serves unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed – but how far will he go when it is someone he loves?
A detached man and his friend organize brutal, bare-knuckle boxing matches.
An American officer is in charge of an all-Jewish squad known as The Basterds and is tasked with the mission of killing as many Nazi troops as possible.
A Navy navigator is shot down over enemy territory and is pursued by a secret police enforcer.
Based on the true story of a war waged in Mogadishu by the high-tech Black Hawk helicopters and the US Army Rangers and Deltas.

In 1965, while bombing Laos, pilot Dieter Dengler crashes in the jungle. Dieter is arrested, tortured and sent to a prison camp, where he organizes an escape plan. A betrayal splits the group and Dieter finds that the jungle is the actual prison.
A Navy navigator is shot down over enemy territory and is pursued by a secret police enforcer.

The Bride wakes up after a long coma. The baby that she carried before entering the coma is gone. The only thing on her mind is to take revenge on the assassination team that betrayed her - a team she was once part of.
Writer-director Quentin Tarantino completes the quest for revenge started in KILL BILL: VOL. 1. The Bride (Uma Thurman) crosses the final names off her death list in KILL BILL: VOL. 2.
